purpose: This table is the cleaned OurAirports airports reference, limited to airports that carry an IATA code, intended to feed airport lookups, geospatial joins, and reference enrichment in downstream models.
usage: Join on iata_code, the declared grain key, which is unique and non-null for every row; treat the continent value 'NA' and any iso_country 'NA' as the literal code for North America / Namibia rather than a missing marker; consumers should expect and handle nulls in elevation_ft, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords rather than assuming completeness.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve the sparsity of several optional columns: local_code is null for 63.6635% of rows, home_link for 74.9034%, keywords for 67.9585%, icao_code for 13.6579%, wikipedia_link for 13.0838%, elevation_ft for 3.6988%, and municipality for 3.9748%; no exact-duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across 9057 rows) so no row removal was performed.
